roundingSurface.note: collateral-management stores basePrice and pctToBase but no API read-back computes basePrice*pctToBase/100*quantity. The loan-collateral link in this build is the legacy m_loan_collateral model keyed by a LoanCollateral code value; POST stores only type_cv_id (value/description null, no quantity). No division or rounding occurs through the API.
